content.rendered:
Professor Sean Hu Xiang – Founder

Professor Sean Hu earned his Ph.D. from Goteborg University and Chalmers University of Technology and received his postdoctoral training in University of British Columbia. He had several International and domestic patents in the aspect of adult stem cells for clinical application.

Exposure:

  • Director of Shenzhen Stem Cell Engineering Technology Research and Development Center 
  • Vice Chairman of China Institute of Strategy & Management (CISM)
  • Member of Committee of International Advisers for the United Nations International Children’s Emergency Fund 
  • Founder and Honorary Chairman of Shenzhen World Health Foundation
  • Executive Chairman of Xiong’an International Health Forum
  • Member of the Guangdong Provincial Political Consultative Conference  (China political legislative advisory body)
  • Group Chairman of Shenzhen Beike Biotechnology Co. Ltd
  • Winner of the first batch of China “Thousand People Plan“
  • Director of the National Joint Engineering Laboratory of Individual Cell Therapy Technology China
  • Director of the Stem Cell Research Institute of China Medical City
  • Vice President of China’s National Strategic Alliance for Technology Innovation in Stem Cell and Regenerative Medicine Industry 
  • Founder of the Boao Forum for Asia World Life Sciences Forum
  • Executive Director of the Technical Committee of Regenerative Medicine, China Pharmaceutical Biotechnology Association 
  • Vice President of Shenzhen International Economic Promotion Association
  • Visiting Professor, Department of Surgery, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
  • Visiting Professor, Shanghai Cardiovascular Research Institute, Fudan University
  • Director of World Children’s Fund Asia
